name: Ember
description: A woman in her mid twenties, a fire spinner at a desert arts festival, who sings pounding tribal house, fierce, focused and joyful.
build: A lithe, athletic adult woman of ordinary proportions: toned shoulders and arms, a straight strong torso, a natural waist, long legs, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Deep brown skin, dark brown eyes under arched black brows, a broad nose, sculpted cheekbones, full lips.
hair: Long black box braids to the middle of the back, gathered at the crown into one thick high ponytail with a wide copper cuff, the braids falling behind the shoulders.
outfit: A fitted sleeveless tan suede leather vest laced at the front with thick cord, high at the neck; fitted dark brown leather trousers with wide tan suede knee panels; a wide burnt-orange cloth sash knotted at the hip; flat brown leather ankle boots; wide copper cuffs on both forearms, ending above the wrists so both hands are bare.
performance_style: Poised and ready: feet shoulder-width, knees soft, weight forward. Both arms hang at her sides, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty, fingers visible. Head high, a calm focused look.
location: Night on the open playa: flat dark clay running to the bottom of the frame lit orange from a big bonfire burning in a steel ring behind, a ring of dim figures in silhouette beyond it, and a black starry sky.
recognition_cues: long black box braids in one thick high ponytail with a copper cuff
a tan suede leather vest and dark brown leather trousers
a burnt-orange sash at the hip
palette: vest and knee panels tan suede #B08050 / #74522F / #D4A878
avoid: fire poi, staffs or flames in her hands

sing.intent: Tribal-house vocal loop: pulse the knees on a four-on-the-floor beat, raise the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth for a chanted phrase, trace a slow wide circle with the open character-left hand like a spinning poi, then lower the mic. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing, then return to the opening stance.

animations.flinch: Brief reaction to a sudden spark: the chin pulls in, the torso leans back and both open hands rise to chest height, then she steadies into her ready stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step into a low wide base, both forearms crossed in front of the chest with open hands, holding a steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stride in with a springy step, spin once in place with both arms out, and land in the shoulder-width ready stance with both hands open.
